tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༁ྃ:zab bdun rgyud zab sgyu 'phrul las:rdor sems thugs kyi sgrub pa bzhugs:

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: zab bdun rgyud zab sgyu 'phrul las: rdor sems thugs kyi sgrub pa bzhugs:

bla ma rdo rje sems la 'dud: de nyid sgrub pa'i rim pa la: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi: dang por tshogs bsags rgyud sbyangs nas: rten mchod thams cad tshogs par bya: mtshams gcod lta ba'i gdings ldan pas: hūm̐: de bzhin nyid kyi ngang nyid las: rim pa bzhin du rigs lnga'i sku: de las phyag mtshan lnga 'phros pas: ye shes me dang bcas pa'i gur: phyag rgya bzhi yis rgyas btab pas: sus kyang gzhom du med par gyur: hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā: rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: bshags yul spyan drangs dpang gsol te: hūm̐: "_ ye nas gnyis med chos skur dag pa la: ma rig dbang gis sgro dang skur btab ste: bde dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs ngo bor smin: de ldog don phyir rgyal bas dam chos ston: bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyi: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te: rgyal ba 'khor bcas thugs dang ci 'gal ba: thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol: dam bca' brtan po bzung nas su: hūm̐: kun tu bzang po bla na med pa yi: byang chub mchog tu bdag ni sems bskyed do: don dam dang ni kun rdzob byang chub sems: bla ma lha khyod rtag tu bzung bar bgyi: rgyas par brjod med bshags pa dang: dam bca' nyi shu la sogs bya: mos gus gdung bas byin chen 'bebs: hūm̐ a la la ho: bha ga wān sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya st+waṃ: 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab: khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab: mthu rtsal phyung ba'i dus la bab: dbang mchog bskur ba'i dus la bab: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: mthu chen bdud thul bcom ldan 'das: byin chen byin phob bcom ldan 'das: dbang chen dbang skur bcom ldan 'das: bdag cag las 'bras mchis par mdzod: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: byin bsdus phyi nang mchod pa rnams: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsregs gtor bkrus: bdud rtsi'i snod ni gzhal yas khang: 'khor lo rtsibs bzhir dam rdzas bcu: sa bon phyag mtshan rigs lnga'i sku:

yab yum mnyam sbyor bdud rtsir zhu: bhandha bdud rtsir oṃ gyis mtshan: rgya gram rta mgrin yum bzhis mnan: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: sbyor ba'i 'od kyis bdud rtsi bskul: 'od zhu bdud rtsir dbyer med 'dres: gtor gzhong bhandha'i nang du ni: gtor ma oṃ las 'dod yon 'phro: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: padma bhañdza'i snod nang du: ra las rakta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: mchod snod zhing khams phun tshogs pa: mchod pa lha mo'i rol par bsam: na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa ma ye swā hā: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga dhū pe dhū: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga puṣpe pu: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga ā lo ke hrī: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga gandhe gan: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i ting 'dzin ni: e ma ho ye nas sangs rgyas kyang: ma rtogs 'gro rnams bsgral bar bya: e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos: skye 'gag gnas dmigs 'gro 'ong rnams: yod min med min mtha' dang bral: chos rnams de bzhin nyid du gnas: ma 'gags snying rjes kun la khyab: zung 'jug ye nas kun tu bzang: thugs nas e yaṃ baṃ laṃ raṃ: spros pas nam mkha' rlung chu sa: ri rab me phung yum lnga'i mkha': bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo gzhal yas khang: sgo bzhi snam bu brgyad dang ldan: bum pa chos 'khor tog gis spras: ye shes rin chen rgyan gyi sprin: gru chad mu khyud 'khor lo'i dbus: rtsibs bzhir seng ge glang chen rta: rma bya shang shang rin po che: padma nyi zla 'tshams pa'i gdan: thabs shes dbus su sems bskyed de: stong nyid ngang las rang rig a: yi ge zhe gnyis sprin gyis mtshan: 'od zhu gong bu hūm̐ du gyur: 'bras bu rdo rje kun tu bzang: ye shes lnga dang ldan pa yi: yab yum mnyam sbyor byang chub sems: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis spros:

hūm̐ oṃ swā āṃḥhāḥ dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' mthing: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen g.yas: dril bu padma ral gri g.yon: dbyings phyug ma dang bde chen 'khril: shar du rnam par snang mdzad dkar: g.yas mthing g.yon dmar dbus dkar zhal: phyag drug 'khor lo la sogs 'dzin: sangs rgyas spyan dang mnyam par 'khril: lho ru rin chen 'byung ldan ser: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ser zhal: phyag drug rin chen la sogs 'dzin: mā ma ki dang mnyam par 'khril: nub tu snang ba mtha' yas dmar: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar zhal: phyag drug padma la sogs 'dzin: gos dkar mo dang mnyam par 'khril: byang du don yod grub pa ljang: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ljang zhal: phyag drug ral gri la sogs 'dzin: dam tshig sgrol ma mnyam par 'khril: yab rnams rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: yum rnams g.yas pas dril bu dang: g.yon rnams rang rtags 'dzin pas 'khril: kṣiṃ hūm̐ trāṃ trāṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ dzriṃ aḥ rtsibs mchan padma nyi zla la: sa yi snying po lā sye dkar: rin chen myu gu me long 'dzin: nam mkha'i snying po mā lye ser: ral gri rin chen phreng ba 'dzin: spyan ras gzigs dbang gīrti dmar: padma dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin: phyag na rdo rje nīrtī mthing: rdo rje gar gyi phyag rgya bsgyur: me dzaḥthiṃlha hūm̐ hūm̐ baṃ mūṃ hoḥ gru bzhir padma nyi zla la: byams pa dhū pe dkar ser mdangs: klu shing spos khang dri bzang 'thul: sgrib sel puṣpe dmar ser mdangs: rin chen 'khor lo me tog 'dzin: kun bzang ā lo ke dmar ljang: rin po che dang sgron me 'dzin: 'jam dpal gandhe ljang dkar mdangs: utpal dri yi dung phor bsnams: kun kyang dril 'dzin sems skyil 'khril: hūm̐ a: shar nub khyams la rin chen khri: padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: kun bzang yab yum nam mkha'i mdog: ting 'dzin phyag rgya skyil krung bzhugs:

de ltar yab yum nyer brgyad rnams: zhi ba'i tshul dgu 'od zer 'bar: yum rnams yab kyi mdog dang mtshungs: rgyan chas bcu gsum dag gis mdzes: 'od zer drug phrag bsam yas 'phro: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i tshul du bskyed: kreṃ sruṃ kṣaṃ braṃ hūm̐ truṃ ye: lhag ma'i khyams la pad rkyang steng: brgya byin dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin: shāka thub ser po gseg par bsnams: kha 'bar ser nag sgrom bu 'dzin: seng rab dmar nag pusti bsnams: thag bzang mthing ga go cha 'dzin: chos rgyal nag po me chu bsnams: chags bral mchog gi sprul sku'i chas: bzhengs stabs 'gro don mdzad pa'i tshul: hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐ hoḥ pho brang sgo bzhir nyi gdan la: gshin rje smug nag nṛ mgo gdengs: lcags kyu ma dang thabs kyis sbyor: stobs chen ser nag rtse lnga 'dzin: zhags pa ma dang thabs kyis sbyor: rta mgrin dmar nag thod dkris sbrul: lcags sgrog ma dang thabs kyis sbyor: 'khyil pa ljang nag rgya gram 'dzin: dril bu ma dang mnyam par sbyor: khro bo'i chas rdzogs 'dor stabs rol: 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa 'o: yon tan rigs mchog 'dzin pa'i phyir: kun bzang bdag dang gnyis su med: 'khor ba'i 'dzin lus phyir thon nas: aṃ ho: kun bzang sbyor ba'i 'od zer gyis: ma dag pa kun dag pa che: gser zhun lta bu'i thig ler gnas: sku gsung thugs thim hūm̐ yig nyid: zla ba rlung bskyod lha tshogs bskor: dkyil 'khor bdag po'i thugs la thim: yab yum bde chen rol pa yi: sku yi dbyibs brgyud yum mkhar gnas: chags chen 'od zhu thig ler gyur: 'khor rnams chags chen rkyen gyis zhu: kun 'dus 'od kyi phung por gyur: hūm̐ mūṃ rdor dril gtso bor gyur: spyi bor rigs lnga snyoms zhugs chus: dbang bskur rigs lngas dbu brgyan gyur: oṃ ma hā shun+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā ā darsha dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ:

oṃ ma hā sa mā tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā pra tya bekṣa ṇa dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ ma hā kṛ tyā nuṣṭha dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: gnas lngar zla nyi padma dang: rin chen rgya gram 'bar ba la: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang swā hās mtshan: rgyal mchod byin rlabs rnam lnga bsdus: rigs lnga yab yum sku ru gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: yab kyi gsang bar rdo rje hūm̐: yum gyi gsang bar padma mūṃ: sa ma ya st+waṃ: sa ma ya ho: ra ho haṃ: rā ga ya mi: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: bo dhi tsitta spha ra ṇa phaṭa: byang sems thig btab pho brang gdan: sa bon dang bcas spros par gyur: sngags kyis lhar bskyed mdun mkhar bton: phaṭa dzaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: yig 'bru gsum gyis sku brtas pas: spro bsdus sangs rgyas mdzad pa sgrub: spha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: dbang bskur bdag dang gnyis su med: rgyal ba sems dpa' sprul pa'i tshogs: so so'i gnas su bzhugs par bya: de nas ye shes 'khor lo ni: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas: chos sku gzugs skur bzhengs par bsam: badzra sa ma ya e hye hi: hūm̐: thugs rje'i lcags kyus thugs dam rgyud bskul zhing: byams pa'i zhags pas gnas nas spyan yang drangs: lcags sgrogs bka' yi pho nyas gnas bskyod la: bde gshegs bzhugs shing mgron rnams dgyes pa bskyed: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: nyer drangs dam ye ro gcig rig: oṃ badzra sa ma ya oṃ: āḥbadzra sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐: sgrib sbyangs dngos grub stsol bar phyogs: oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐: oṃ badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ: oṃ badzra sa ma ya ho:

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa gnyis med bstim: tiṣṭha badzra: 'gro don rdzogs par bzhugs par bsam: de nas phyag mchod bstod pa ni: lha la lha rol tshul gyis ni: a ti pu ho: pra tītstsha ho: spro na phyag rgya bzhi yis mchod: hūm̐ oṃ: bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes kyis: srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun: kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhya: sarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: yang dag don du dag mod kyang: 'gro ba yongs kyi don slad du: phyag dang zhabs ni bsil nas kyang: rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: oṃ ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bidyā dha ra pū dzi te na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa ma ye swā hā: hūm̐: spos kyi sprin lding bdug pa mo: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gdugs kyis 'gebs: byams pa thabs dang shes rab las: badzra dhū pe'i mchod pa rol: oṃ pa na peṃ: pe nu su ra to: ti pu pa ra mu: sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi hū: sa ma yo ta mu: sarba ma hā su kha siddhi hūm̐: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga dhū pe dhū: utpal mthing ga me tog 'thor: sna tshogs rin chen 'od du 'phro: snying rje thabs dang shes rab las: badzra puṣpe'i mchod pa rol: oṃ pa na peṃ: pe nu su ra to: ti pu pa ra mu: sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi hū: sa ma yo ta mu: sarba ma hā su kha siddhi hūm̐: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga puṣpe pu: hrī: dbang gi phyag rgya sgron me bsnams: chos kyi rgyal po 'bar ba 'dzin: dga' ba thabs dang shes rab las: badzra ā lo ke'i mchod pa rol: oṃ pa na peṃ: pe nu su ra to: ti pu pa ra mu: sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi hū: sa ma yo ta mu: sarba ma hā su kha siddhi hūm̐: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga ā lo ke hrī: tsandan bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs ma: dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i thig le 'bebs: btang snyoms thabs dang shes rab las:

badzra gandhe'i mchod pa rol: oṃ pa na peṃ: pe nu su ra to: ti pu pa ra mu: sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi hū: sa ma yo ta mu: sarba ma hā su kha siddhi hūm̐: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga gandhe gan: hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam dag pa'i: bdud rtsi rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar: dug lnga sel ba sman gyi mchog: rmad byung mchod pa bzhes su gsol: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: kā ya wā ka tsitta siddhi oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: khams gsum chags pa'i 'dzin pa bsgral: chags med chags bral dmar chen po: dug gsum rnam par sbyong ba'i phyir: dkyil 'khor lha rnams bzhes su gsol: ma hā rakta pra tītstsha kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa: ye shes lnga yi mchod sprin che: byin rlabs gtor ma'i mchod sprin 'di: mchod do bzhes shig dgyes par mdzod: ma hā ba liṃ ta pra tītstsha kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: thabs shes mnyam sbyor bde chen sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun mchod de: 'khor ba'i 'khrul rtog thams cad bsgral: mnyam nyid spros bral ye mchod 'bul: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: bo dhi tsitta spha ra ṇa phaṭa: dharma dhā tu shuddha ā: oṃ: phyogs bcu dus bzhi rdzogs pa yi: ye shes dkyil 'khor thig le che: bsod nams dkyil 'khor sku yi tshogs: snang stong thig le kun tu rdzogs ho: oṃ: rdo rje bsod nams thig le che: rdo rje ye shes dkyil 'khor ldan: rdo rje sgra chen mtha' yas pa: rdo rje rgyal po thig le che ho: oṃ: sku gsung thugs kyi rdzogs pa che: yon tan phrin las kun tu rdzogs: ye nas lhun rdzogs kun tu bzang: 'dus pa'i tshogs chen thig le che ho: oṃ: mi dmigs rdzu 'phrul mnyam pa'i dbyings: mtha' yas kun nas lha tshogs spro: mtha' yas kun nas kun gyis thim: sna tshogs sku gsung thugs chen po ho: oṃ: phyogs bcu 'jig rten rdul snyed du:

rgyal ba'i don rnams rdul phran snyed: sprul pa'i rdul phran bsam yas kyis: skad cig yud la lhun gyis grub ho: oṃ: thams cad ma lus sku gsung thugs: sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid che: sku gsung thugs kyis kun tu khyab: sku gsung thugs kyi thig le che ho: spro na mchod pa bcu drug 'bul: yig brgyas nongs bshags dam bca' bzung: ho: sgyu 'phrul rang bzhin lha tshogs rnams: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can la: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: de nas sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi: 'od zer dkar po phar 'phros pas: rgyud sbyangs dngos grub snod du byas: 'od zer dmar po bsnol ma yis: dngos grub ma lus bsdus par bsam: phaṭa dza sa 'dzab khang dbye nas su: phar 'phros ye shes lha tshogs mchod: tshur 'phros dngos grub bdag la bstsal: bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi tshad dang sbyar: rgyas par so so'i snying po bzla: yang na kun dril spyi 'dzab ni: oṃ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu ā: rtags tshad ldan na dngos grub blang: ta na gha ṇa las la sbyar: gzhan yang thun mtshams rnams su ni: dzap bstod bshags pa dam ye bstim: rjes kyi bya ba tshogs mchod ni: longs spyod ci 'byor bdud rtsir bsag:

tshogs gzhong nyi ma 'bar ba dang: tshogs rdzas oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ ye shes lnga yi 'od zer gyis: 'dod yon lha mo'i rol par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor rnams: rang snang dag pa'i tshul gyis ni: nye bar dgongs te gshegs su gsol: badzra sa mā dza: mchod sprin phyi nang gsang bas mchod: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi tshogs mchod 'di: thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tītstsha ho: tshe rabs thog ma med pa tshun chad nas: da lta'i lus 'di blang ba phan chad du: lus kyis sdig byas spyod pa ngan du spyod: ngag gis tshig rtsub 'khyal smra ngan du brjod: sems kyis blo nor log par sems la sogs: 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs bgyis pa: bkram pa'i lha tshogs rnams la bzod par gsol: ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang: de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin rnams: mi yi skyon mthong tsam nas bar chad brtsam: nongs shing 'gal 'khrul ci bgyis mthol lo bshags: oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya bzlas: brda dang brda yi 'bul len gyis: zab mo nang gi sbyin bsreg bya: lhag ma'i maṇḍal mchod gtor bsham: rtsa ba las kyi dkyil 'khor rnams: bhrūm̐ hūm̐ oṃ swā āṃḥhā: zla ba la gnas 'bru gsum gyis: 'dod yon gsang ba'i longs spyod bsam: e ā ralli hriṃ hriṃ:mgron rnams bkug nas zil gyis mnan: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rigs lnga rnams dang mnyam par sbyor: oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ ba liṃ ta hūm̐ phaṭa: buddha ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ ba liṃ ta oṃ phaṭa: ratna ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ ba liṃ ta trāṃ phaṭa: padma ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ ba liṃ ta hrīḥphaṭa: karma ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ ba liṃ ta āḥphaṭa:

hūm̐: sngon tshe bcom ldan rigs lnga yis: mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis po: slas su mdzad nas khas blangs bzhin: gsang ba'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la: 'di na yang dag don spyod kyi: phrin las ma lus khyed kyis sgrubs: ya hi gatstsha sa rang gnas gshegs: gtor ma mu ran bar du bskyal: hūm̐: lhag dkyil rang gi snying gar bsdu: srung ma'i gtor ma byin gyis brlab: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: bhrūm̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: sngon tshe gsang ba'i gnas mchog tu: rgyal ba sems dpa' rnal 'byor ma'i: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i: bka' yi srung ma 'khor dang bcas: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di longs la: zhal bzhes dam bca' de bzhin du: sgrub pa'i stongs grogs phrin las mdzod: brtan ma'i gtor ma byin gyis brlab: trāṃ ratna trai lo kya phaṭa: gtor ma rdul phran re re bzhin: rin chen gur khyim longs spyod gyur: 'bru gsum dag gis byin gyis brlab: yang dag zla gam lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa'i brtan ma ni: hūm̐: tshogs dang bka' yi tshogs bcas nyid: khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku: tshur gshegs tshur gshegs skyong ma rnams: 'dir byon dam skong dngos grub stsol: brtan ma skyong mdzad ma dang sring: dpal gnas ma dang yang dag shes: khyung btsun kong lha g.yu bun ma: me tog zla 'od byang rgyal ma: gser thang kun bzang shīntaṃ dpal: klu mo gzi 'bar la sogs pa'i: brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas: a su ra yi brag phug tu: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang: rlangs chen dpal gyi seng ge yi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: dam rdzas bka' yi gtor ma longs: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ la lā: le le: taṃ taṃ: te te: kha ragma: ma ma sring 'gro ma hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ hūm̐: ma hā pañtsa a mṛta rakta ba liṃ ta khā hi: srung ma gatstsha sa gshegs par bya: gtor gzhong sbubs la bro yang brdung: yā yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: ye shes zhi ba chen po rnams:

thugs rje chen po'i bro brdungs pas: gti mug rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun: nyon mongs bdud dang mi mthun tshogs: yud tsam gyis ni zhi mdzad pa'i: zhi ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: mā yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: ngo mtshar brjid pa chen po rnams: rngams pa'i yid kyis bro brdungs pas: nga rgyal rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun: dpal dang gzi brjid chen po rnams: yud tsam gyis ni rgyas par mdzad: rgyas pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: waṃ gyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: bde ba chen po'i gar bsgyur zhing: chags pa'i yid kyis bro brdungs pas: 'dod chags rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun: rgyal blon pho mo 'bru nor rnams: yud tsam gyis ni dbang du sdud: dbang gi phrin las 'grub par mdzod: e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: 'bar ba gtum chen rngam pa rnams: khros pa'i yid kyis bro brdungs pas: zhe sdang rdo rje 'khor bcas kyis: 'jig rten khams ni rab 'byams kun: ru dra dgra bgegs ma lus pa: yud tsam gyis ni brlag par mdzad: drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: gtang rag mchod bstod nongs pa bshags: hūm̐: sems can don phyir nan tan mchog bskyed de: ye shes thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dam pa rnams: bdag la bstsal zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: kā ya wāka tsitta tiṣṭha badzra: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang srid dkyil 'khor 'od du zhu: lhar snang 'od gsal ngang du bsdu: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan: haṃ zhu khro bos lus gtams nas: ye shes lnga yi dbang dang ldan: snang srid phyag rgya bzhi ru gyur: badzra kā wā tsi rakṣa haṃ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ oṃ swā āṃḥhā: spyod lam kun tu phyag rgyar ldan: dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis bya:

'di ni lam gyi mthar thug yin: de phyir rtse gcig nyams len bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya: kho bo mchog gyur gling pas nam mkha' mdzod nas spyan drangs shing zangs shog las zhal bshus pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// //
